g.text: 443 Mw grade-A events · 10.1 s multitaper stacks · same retained spectra and source constants
Band ratios and the blue J fraction are conditional on the direct Brune fit; they are not measured missing energy.
The stringent paper benchmark is a diagnostic reference, not a requirement for plateau-based Mw. Grade A assesses moment, not a resolved corner or stress drop.
